newsitem.title: USA: Dames & Moore/Brookhill buys contaminated property.
newsitem.headline: Dames & Moore/Brookhill buys contaminated property.

text.p: Dames & Moore/Brookhill LLC said it has acquired 10 contaminated properties and the mortgages on 14 similarly impaired real estate assets from Confederation Life Insurance Co.

Dames & Moore/Brookhill is a joint venture of Dames & Moore Inc, and The Brookhill Group, one of the nation's foremost real estate turnaround specialists. Confederation Life is being liquidated by order of the Commissioner of Insurance of the State of Michigan.
The total purchase price for the property was $72 million, Dames & Moore/Brookhill said. Acquisition financing was provided by affiliates of Credit Suisse First Boston Mortgage Capital.

The joint venture said 12 of the 24 sites are in California, with the remainder distributed among 11 other states. The portfolio includes office buildings, shopping centers, and manufacturing, light industrial and warehouse sites.
"As a sizable portfolio acquisition with Wall Street financing, this is a first-of-its-kind transaction for the brownfields movement," Dames & Moore/Brookhill chief executive Bruce-Sean Reshen said.
"It signals that viable exit strategies are finally at hand for owners and lenders plagued by contaminated property."
